name: charter
description: Contract-first APIs on Cloudflare Workers with Huma (Go) or oRPC (TypeScript): OpenAPI and AsyncAPI generated, SDKs in any language with Fern, a CLI, MCP and real-time. Go at TypeScript's cost.
